conflicts.description: Switch Reference p13 Trough Opto prints 515-0215-00 tx / 515-0215-01 rx; the long-range opto assembly BOM p36 prints 500-0215-00 emitter / 500-0215-01 receiver. The common suffix and assembly class suggest a prefix discrepancy, but exact assembly-to-trough fitment is not independently proven. Both literal assertions are retained; no canonical sensor PN selected. Resolution path: consult factory revision/parts documentation or inspect the actual trough sensor and its assembly marking.

The manual CPU DIP/service numbering omits 0-SW-1 and shifts the subsequent printed addresses; exact ROM Node 0 positions 0–7 mirror physical DIP ordinals 1–8 as public 101–108 and positions 8–11 are Select/Plus/Minus/Back public 109–112. Canonical public bindings follow verified ROM routing; source-literal addresses remain aliases. Resolution path: check factory CPU mapping documentation or exact machine wiring to resolve the printed numbering discrepancy; do not remap the API from printed IDs alone.

mechanisms.behavior: P36 score bank511-7614-00 has four511-7648-00 score reel assemblies and eight520-5307-00 white LED boards; credit bank511-7615-00 has one511-7648-01 credit reel and one white LED. Individual reel has direct shaft041-5105-00 unipolar stepper motor,515-9819-00 reel,535-1131-00 motor bracket and one520-6960-00 opto home sensor. Switch46..50 names Credit,1s,10s,100s,1000s homes. P28 controller520-6961-00 receives Node11 LP enable/phase channels and supplies two polarities for each physical motor phase. CN6 home inputs return to CN5 home outputs, while CN5pin7 exposes one aggregated M1 OCP/OCP signal. P26 sensor pinout explicitly supplies5V/signal/ground. This proves five separate actuators and five home inputs; the internal channels do not bind independently as public coils. Ball path is inapplicable to these backbox mechanisms. Internal enable/phase lines are manual Driver17..31 atNode11 LP15..1; they are withheld from the public lamp export and are not public coils17..31. GetMech can expose internal subsystem positions, but no digit calibration or exact registration order is asserted by this draft. Unresolved: No step/digit calibration, rotation direction, enable/phase sequence, default digit, startup homing order, home polarity, current-limit semantics, jam/retry/reset timing or calibrated motion rate is established.
mechanisms.label: Credit physical reel
